summary: F5 is fixed: `AppProject.snapshot` now applies the same 256-entry total that `install` applies, counting source, assets and build together, including the two `dist/` entry files. A new temp test checks that a 262-entry project is refused and that a 252-entry snapshot installs into a fresh project. The round-1 fixes are unchanged, all temp tests pass, every changed line is covered or has an accepted exemption, and no P0 or P1 finding remains.
